title: 5-Year Treasury Note auction (November new issue) — the belly leg of Thanksgiving week's three-day coupon block
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream by the treasury-2y-note-2026-11-23 initial-research adjacency sweep. Row reads verbatim `5-Year NOTE Thursday, November 19, 2026 Tuesday, November 24, 2026 Monday, November 30, 2026` with NO trailing `R`, so a new issue. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and a lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-11-19 announcement itself. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the treasury-2y-note-2026-11-23 initial-research adjacency sweep, which found it at D+1 inside the 5-day corridor and untracked. Same pattern the treasury-2y-note-2026-10-26 sweep followed when it proposed treasury-5y-note-2026-10-27 and treasury-7y-note-2026-10-29: the 5Y sells off the SAME 11-19 announcement as the proposing 2Y and settles the SAME day (11-30), so it inherits whatever that announcement establishes and is not an independent read. A SIBLING LANE CALLED THIS THE OTHER WAY AND THE DISAGREEMENT IS RECORDED HERE SO NOBODY RE-LITIGATES IT: proposals/treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19.from-treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19.json (2026-09-08) deliberately declined to file the 5Y, 7Y and FRN separately, on the ground that their natural owner is the announcement — citing treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-12, which declined the 3Y and 10Y refunding legs for the same reason. That precedent is the wrong analogue: 11-12's legs are QUARTERLY REFUNDING securities whose owner really is treasury-refunding-2026-11-04, whereas the 5Y and 7Y are monthly month-end sales, and this calendar already carries treasury-5y-note-2026-10-27 and treasury-7y-note-2026-10-29 as their own canonical files from the identical October block. Filing November the same way keeps the two blocks comparable; the announcement proposal stands unchanged and is not competed with. SIZE IS UNPUBLISHED TODAY, deliberately not guessed: `sb0590` (2026-08-05, read direct 2026-09-09) publishes anticipated coupon sizes only through `Oct-26`, where the 5-Year column reads 70; the November grid arrives at the 2026-11-04 refunding. WHAT MAKES THIS SLOT DISTINCT FROM ITS OCTOBER SIBLING: it shares 11-24 with the 2-Year FRN reopening off the same announcement, so Tuesday carries two Treasury sales, and it prices the session before the compressed macro Wednesday (PCE, GDP-Q3-second, durable goods, new home sales, beige book, all 11-25).
